version: 3.6 (feature/jungle-setting-3.6) — Deep Jungle on Balanced, with Desert Outpost and TokyoNight regression in the same session
machine: Apple M5, Chrome, ANGLE Metal, 120 Hz display, DPR 2, same window and session
method: __dev.bench(3) with the Balanced preset applied in memory (pixel ratio 1.25, 60 FPS cap, 3 bloom levels; the saved settings were not changed). Jungle run 1 had foliage built at High density (the level was loaded before the preset switch); run 2 rebuilt it at Balanced density.
notes: P95 ~23 ms appears in every setting and in 3.4's numbers: frame pacing of a 60 FPS cap on a 120 Hz display, not jungle cost.
Foliage density barely moves GPU time (−51k triangles, no measurable change): the instanced, opaque undergrowth is not the bottleneck, so no foliage optimisation was needed.
Each foliage InstancedMesh spans the whole map (one bounding sphere), so it is never frustum-culled; all ~324k triangles are submitted every frame at ~6 ms GPU.
Not measured: temperature or wattage; weaker GPUs.
